findings.description: The bucket is deliberately configured without an ACL, bucket policy, or Public Access Block that restricts public access; the configuration comments indicate it is public. This can expose the customer-master object and any other bucket contents to unauthenticated internet users.

No server-side encryption default is configured for this bucket, so stored objects are not enforced to use encryption at rest. This increases exposure if underlying stored data is accessed outside intended S3 authorization paths.
The financials bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving financial data without Terraform-enforced encryption at rest.
The operations bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so objects can be stored without encryption at rest enforced by the bucket.
The data_science bucket does not configure default server-side encryption, leaving stored data without an encryption-at-rest requirement.
